intro: Five stats exist: Level, Hit Points, Strength, Defence and Movement. Never train Movement — it does nothing in the current Battledome.

sections.title: Before level 250
points: Train Level only, at the Mystery Island school (tan codestones).
Faerie Quests daily, Kitchen Quests when convenient.
sections.note: Swashbuckling Academy is paid in dubloons and trains to level 40 — usually cheaper for the early levels.

sections.title: After level 250
points: Train whichever of HP, Strength or Defence is lowest.
When it stops, raise Level and go back.

sections.title: The cap
points: A stat only trains to twice your level.
Hit Points can reach three times, but once HP is above twice your level nothing else will train until Level catches up — so do not over-feed HP.

items.text: Bubbling Fungus — best cheap Strength boost, about 86k, average +1.8.
items.label: Bubbling Fungus

items.text: Snegg — +2 to 3 Hit Points, but around 4m each.
items.label: Snegg

items.text: Cool Negg — Level, HP and Strength, around 5m. Not worth it routinely.
items.label: Cool Negg
